entries.description: Stream now shows recent updates, with clearer player controls and a darker navigation bar

changelog.title: New
items: Open the LuvLyrics logo in Stream to see the latest four versions and what changed

changelog.title: Improved
items: Player animations follow your phone’s reduced-motion setting
Connect devices from one easy-to-find panel
The mini-player has softer corners and sits more clearly above the darker navigation bar

entries.description: Finding lyrics and using player and import controls is easier

changelog.title: New
items: Find lyrics for more versions of the same song

changelog.title: Improved
items: Blends, navigation labels and music imports are easier to use
Songs with the same title and artist match across more sources
Player and Luvs animations follow your phone’s reduced-motion setting

entries.description: This release included no visible changes in the Android app.
Jump back in and fullscreen lyrics are easier to use, and removed downloads are easier to restore

changelog.title: Improved
items: Jump back in shows song names more clearly
Fullscreen lyrics have more room and a slimmer control bar
Download a song again from its menu after removing it
